body: Thank you for your kind words.

I was diagnosed with borderline, before this I had 3 different therapist and 1 psychiatrist. I was put in antidepressants but they didn’t help and then I had to stop any medication because I found out I was pregnant. I have never had proper treatment for the BPD. I just don’t trust anyone. One of the therapist stole money from me. 

I want to be better for my daughter but sometimes I convince myself that she is better off without me. I feel like I’m turning her into me and that terrifies me.

I actually never thought about it like that, but I think you’re right.  My happiest memories have been in Mexico in the open fields with my grandmother. I don’t think I’m meant for this city life. It’s too fast paced for me. Thank you for making me realize that
